revisions.reason: Crimsonland DX8.1 review 20261122: DIRECTX_MODULE_VERSIONS gains D3D8.DLL 4.08.01.0881, so the staticModule C:\WINDOWS\SYSTEM\D3D8.DLL placeholder carries an RT_VERSION like OPENGL32/COMCTL32. Data-only change to the boot-time VFS file bytes; no callback, guest entry, asynchronous boundary, context restoration or lifetime change. test-directx-system-files.js covers it; broader invocation ownership remains pending.

revisions.reason: macOS shared-heap process key review 20261122: the CLI shared-heap process birth token moves into cliProcessBirthKey(), which keeps /proc/self/stat on Linux and reads ps lstart (whole epoch seconds) where /proc is absent, instead of throwing ENOENT at the first shared-heap call. Same pid:birth key shape and same once-per-process caching; no callback, guest entry, scheduling, context restoration or lifetime change. test-cli-process-birth-key.js covers it; broader invocation ownership remains pending.
